title: Search In A Binary Search Tree
description: Given the root of a binary search tree (BST) and an integer val, find the node in the BST that the node's value equals val and return the subtree rooted with that node.

steps.note: Initialize search at the root node (val: 4).
Check if current node value 4 equals target 2. False.
Target 2 is less than 4, traverse to left child.
Check if current node value 2 equals target 2. True, return node.
